3. Metagaming is expressly prohibited
## Subtext - This is a roleplay game first and foremost. While a call is likely, you CAN NOT act on any knowledge gained outside of the game.
- Characters are allowed to have persistent knowledge/relationships/friendships with the following caveats: -- Knowledge of a character being an antagonist from a previous round is not used maliciously. -- Character friendships/relationships/rivalries are not exploitative in nature or used to gain an unfair advantage. Having an IC friendship with another player does not justify, for example, giving them all-access each round. It also does not justify firing a player every round because you have an IC rivalry with said character
